messages.author: e14da3c63f78ec61
messages.subject: Conceptual and empirical convergence
parts:
Hello,

I want to examine to what extent three novel sub-scales, explained by a second-order factor, converge empirically with an established dimension. Since they are all latent factors, how can I examine that on lavaan? I think I should look at the amount of variance that the established measure explains in each sub-scale. Not sure about how to do that on lavaan.

Thank you very much,

Zuzanne

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Conceptual and empirical convergence
parts: Since they are all latent factors, how can I examine that on lavaan?
You could include the established scale, too, then look at the correlation between the factors defined by the novel vs. established scale items.
I think I should look at the amount of variance that the established measure explains in each sub-scale.

You could regress the novel subscale factors on the established-scale, then request R^2 in your summary

summary(fit, rsquare = TRUE)
